findings: The manuscript uses the old matched2 numerator and a later floor_disjoint denominator, rather than the matched numerator rerun alongside that denominator. These are distinct native builds.
Every IvfPq disjoint R095 floor has placeable=false despite a recall gap <=0.004. Achieved recalls are 0.939/0.9415, 0.927/0.9295, 0.966/0.966.
The gap criterion compares the two builds within each pair; it does not establish common achieved recall across numerator and floor.
Equal-per-query-recall conditioning selects different query subsets and recall strata for every pair. It is descriptive, not a causal adjustment or proof of a zero rewrite-specific contribution.
HnswFlat R095 independent floors satisfy the stated target window and gap, but one independent pair per seed remains insufficient to establish equivalence or isolate a causal maintenance effect.
Byte-identical physical row ordering rules out that measured mediator; it does not establish ANN build nondeterminism as the sole cause, or certify native structural incompatibility.
recommended_replacement: At nominal R=0.95, equal-recall answer-change rates are 17.6% (HnswFlat) and 20.1% (IvfPq) in the matched2 maintenance runs, while independent rebuild pairs record 22.3% and 22.0%. The IvfPq floor pairs achieve 0.939/0.9415, 0.927/0.9295 and 0.966/0.966, outside the target window; each pair is internally mean-recall matched. These descriptive controls show substantial variation between rebuilds but do not isolate or rule out a rewrite-specific component. They do not provide in-engine structural certification.
